name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-regulated insulin secretion
rationale: Members span pancreatic progenitor-to-endocrine (beta, alpha) lineage programs plus insulin processing and GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion, which the endoderm, ductal/intestinal epithelial and receptor-regulated insulin secretion confusables lack in combination.

name: Lactate, pyruvate and TCA-intermediate carboxylate membrane transport
rationale: Members concern SLC transport of monocarboxylates (lactate, pyruvate via MCT/basigin) and di/tricarboxylates (succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate shuttle), distinguishing them from the carnitine/choline and cationic amino acid transport confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly including centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: All members concern loading of histones or proteins onto chromatin, notably CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, unlike the histone acetylation, chromatin disassembly and chromosome condensation confusables.

qualifier: choline and GABA uptake, synaptic vesicle loading
name: Choline and GABA uptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading
rationale: Members cover SLC-mediated choline (SLC5A7) and GABA reuptake, organic cation transport and vesicular neurotransmitter loading/acidification, distinct from the glutamate/glycine, monoamine and cholinergic transmission confusables.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing and dendritic cell chemotaxis
name: Homing chemokine signalling for lymphocyte and dendritic cell migration
rationale: The four members (lymphocyte homing adhesion, myeloid dendritic cell chemotaxis, and the Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signalling they engage) share homing-chemokine-driven migration, narrower than the general chemokine, integrin and S1P confusables.

core: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity
name: Activation of NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK and cytotoxic T cell signatures and positive regulation of their cytotoxicity, degranulation, cytokine production and proliferation, whereas confusables carry KIR inhibitory receptors and negative regulation/tolerance.

name: Glucose-induced transcription via ChREBP activation
rationale: All members concern glucose-driven transcriptional activation through ChREBP (including its PP2A dephosphorylation), unlike confusables on AMPK/PKA inhibition of ChREBP, lipogenic nuclear receptors and adipogenesis.

qualifier: retention, ER exit control and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: ER protein quality control, retention and ERAD retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER quality-control compartment, mannose trimming, ER retention and exit regulation and ER-to-cytosol retrotranslocation for ERAD, distinct from the ER targeting/insertion and COPII export confusables.

name: Regulation of p53-mediated DNA damage intrinsic apoptotic signalling
rationale: All members are positive or negative regulation of p53-class DNA damage signalling and intrinsic apoptosis, whereas confusables are TP53 transcriptional targets, p21 arrest or senescence.

name: Cardiomyocyte sarcolemmal membrane domains and integrin-ILK adhesion
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte membrane architecture (T-tubules, rafts/caveolae, gap junctions, cell adhesion, excitability) and ILK-PINCH-parvin integrin adhesions, unlike the desmosome and sarcomere contraction confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism, thyroid hormone action and peroxide homeostasis
rationale: Members cover selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation, thyroid hormone generation/transport/signalling and H2O2/ROS regulation (selenoenzyme-linked), distinguishing them from ROS detoxification, SLC26 anion/iodide transport and vitamin C confusables.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly
rationale: All members concern assembly and acylglycerol loading of chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables concern lipoprotein remodelling and clearance.

name: Mucin O-glycan synthesis and terminal fucosylated, sialylated antigens
rationale: Members span GalNAc O-glycosylation and its defects, antenna elongation, sialylation, fucosylation and ABO/Lewis/selectin-ligand epitopes, distinct from the N-glycan trimming, sialic acid metabolism and sulfation confusables.

name: FLT3 receptor signalling and CBL-mediated attenuation
rationale: All members concern wild-type FLT3 signalling via SRC kinases and its negative regulation by CBL (including CBL mutants), unlike confusables on TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants and RUNX transcription.

name: Placental trophoblast and mammary gland development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover trophoblast/labyrinth/decidual placentation and mammary lineage, branching, alveolar development and lactation, distinguishing them from prostate/genital and early embryo lineage confusables.

qualifier: Rac and Cdc42 driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: Rac and Cdc42 GTPase cycles driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
rationale: Members are Rac1/2/3, Cdc42, RhoG and RhoJ GTPase cycles and WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 lamellipodium formation, distinct from RhoA/B/C-formin and NADPH oxidase confusables.

qualifier: lysosomal downregulation of receptor tyrosine kinases
name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of receptor tyrosine kinases
rationale: Members concern clathrin/ubiquitin-dependent internalisation and MVB sorting of RTKs such as EGFR and MET (exploited by Listeria InlB), unlike the ESCRT budding/exosome and MET signalling confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud induction
name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct formation and ureteric bud induction/branching, earlier than the nephron morphogenesis and ureter elongation confusables.

qualifier: STAT5/STAT3 via haematopoietic, IL-6-family and growth-hormone receptors
name: JAK-STAT5/STAT3 signalling by haematopoietic, IL-6-family and growth-hormone receptors
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO, TPO, FLT3/fusion kinase, IL-6-family, GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signalling through STAT5/STAT3 and ERK, unlike the IL-10/12/15/21/23/27 and Th2/mast cell confusables.

name: T cell immunological synapse formation, polarity and heterotypic adhesion
rationale: Members concern T cell synapse formation, raft localization, polarity, aggregation and heterotypic adhesion/docking, distinguishing them from integrin-activation-only and CD28-Vav/CORO1A signalling confusables.

name: Integrin activation and heterotypic cell-cell adhesion
rationale: All members concern integrin activation driving heterotypic cell-cell adhesion and membrane docking (including PECAM1), unlike the Rap1/MAPK integrin signalling, endothelial adhesion-inhibition and T cell synapse confusables.

name: Amino acid and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: Members concern leucine/amino acid and glucose/LKB1-AMPK inputs that switch TORC1 on or off, whereas confusables are amino acid transport, mTORC1/p53 metabolic target genes and AKT-FOXO.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling, clearance and cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members cover LDL/HDL remodelling, LDL/VLDL/chylomicron clearance, lipoprotein transport and cholesterol import, distinct from the lipoprotein assembly, lipase and intestinal absorption confusables.

qualifier: mitotic maturation, positioning and spindle assembly
name: Centrosome maturation, positioning and microtubule nucleation for spindle assembly
rationale: Members concern mitotic centrosome protein recruitment, AURKA-TPX2, microtubule nucleation/anchoring, centrosome positioning and spindle assembly, unlike confusables on chromosome cohesion/condensation, cilia/centriole duplication, spindle orientation and APC/C.

name: Circadian clock-driven transcription and sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members cover BMAL1/CLOCK/NPAS-driven circadian transcription, locomotor rhythm and sleep/wake regulation with clock-linked beta-cell proliferation and FOXO outputs, distinguishing them from orexin/feeding and gluconeogenic confusables.
